name: grade-7-math
description: Reason about percent, chance and signed values.

interface.longDescription: Reason about percent, chance and signed values. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Compare percent change; Add signed numbers; Compare observed chance. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Number Steps: Grade 7 Math workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.prompt: Help me compare percent change with these supplied values: {"original":80,"updated":92}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_7_math_percent_change with the supplied inputs. Returns {"difference":12,"percent_change":15,"multiplier":1.15}. Shows the actual percent result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me add signed numbers with these supplied values: {"start":-3,"changes":[5,-7,4]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_7_math_signed_walk with the supplied inputs. Returns {"start":-3,"steps":[{"change":5,"position":2},{"change":-7,"position":-5},{"change":4,"position":-1}],"answer":-1}. Shows the actual number-line result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me compare observed chance with these supplied values: {"favorable":3,"total":8,"trials":40}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_7_math_chance_model with the supplied inputs. Returns {"probability":{"numerator":3,"denominator":8,"decimal":0.375},"expected_count":15,"note":"Expected count is a long-run average, not a guarantee."}. Shows the actual probability result. Does not fabricate external data.
